message:
NPCAnimController perf improvements
Throttle the animator param calculations if the animal has been culled, max once every 0.25
Check the livestock have changed flags before setting the animator params
Disable the F Look component when an animal is culled or if the animal is > 30m away
Don't do the snap to ground raycast if we are culled
In a scene with 40 cows, this reduces FLook and NPCAnimController total of 0.6ms to 0.1ms when occluded, 0.3ms when at a distance
Vendor typo fix
Added item ownership for items purchased from livestock vendor
Fixed wrong text displayed if player drops wool mid conversation
biofuel_generator_optims -> main
Add ability to turn off background errors by setting -1 in the manifest (incase it completely breaks)
- Add an animator LOD
Send the livestock to sell via an RPC rather than relying on client side triggers to match up with server side triggers

- Run client animations in invoke repeating
- Only run stirring animations when actually stirring
- Run server updates in invoke randomised rather than invoke repeating

Add additional rate limiting to background errors
- I expect these can be spammy, so limit to 2 errors per minute
- controlled by manifest so it can be increased if we want

- while the owner could still go in and out, the "anyone can let themselves out" wouldn't work

Fix crashes from previous updates being uploaded despite not having the sentry tags written
- don't upload old crashes (if we made it past bootstrap but didn't write a crash marker)
- still upload crashes that never made it to bootstrap (since this is before crash marker could be written)
- tag crashes that didn't make it to bootstrap as "bootstrap crashes" so we can see what crashes happened really early
- if we find a bunch of crashes happening before bootstrap we will find a way to include the actual changeset (since we don't read changeset until we get to bootstrap)
